description: Search listed private clubs by name, city, club type, US state or Canadian province, amenities and listed waitlist status. Returns up to 25 clubs with a profile url. Membership fees are not returned

amenities.description: Clubs listing every amenity given. Each value must match a stored amenity exactly; most are lower case codes such as golf_course, swimming_pool, tennis or driving_range

query.description: Club name, type or city (matches any). Add a place after a comma: City, State in the US and Canada or City, Country elsewhere (e.g. Naples, Florida or Sydney, Australia)

state.description: US state or Canadian province full name (e.g. Florida, California, New York, Ontario). Full names only.

type.description: Club type: golf, city, yacht, athletic, beach, equestrian, ski, automotive, aviation, outdoor, business, wellness, dining

waitlist.description: Only clubs listed as open to new members (few clubs carry this status)

name: search_clubs
title: Search Private Clubs
